title: Timepoint 1 — Hepatology clinic: involuntary weight loss
scenarioBrief: You are seeing Janet Brooks in hepatology clinic today (4/10/2027). Her primary care physician referred her for about three months of unintentional weight loss and poor appetite, on a background of alcohol-related cirrhosis with ongoing alcohol use. The chart holds her prior records. Please review the chart and answer the question below.

chartGate._notes: TP1 visibility: the 2/15 PCP note and her background history ONLY.
